title: MATH GAOKAO - 174
description: Authentic-style mathematics problems inspired by China’s Gaokao — build deeper understanding, sharper thinking, and real exam readiness.

questions.learningObjective: Find the position vector of a point dividing a segment internally in a given ratio.
questions.question: Given \(A(2,4)\) and \(B(8,10)\), point \(P\) divides \(AB\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=1:2\). Find the coordinates of \(P\).
questions.explanation:
For internal division with \(AP:PB=m:n\), the position vector of \(P\) is
\[
P=\frac{nA+mB}{m+n}.
\]
Here \(m=1\) and \(n=2\), so
\[
P=\frac{2(2,4)+1(8,10)}{3}
=\left(\frac{4+8}{3},\frac{8+10}{3}\right)
=(4,6).
\]

questions.learningObjective: Find the position vector of a point dividing a segment internally in a given ratio.
questions.question: Given \(A(0,0)\) and \(B(6,9)\), point \(P\) divides \(AB\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=2:1\). Find the coordinates of \(P\).
questions.explanation:
Using the section formula,
\[
P=\frac{nA+mB}{m+n}.
\]
Here \(m=2\) and \(n=1\), so
\[
P=\frac{1(0,0)+2(6,9)}{3}
=\left(\frac{12}{3},\frac{18}{3}\right)
=(4,6).
\]
questions.hint: Substitute the ratio values into the internal section formula.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the coordinates of a point dividing a segment in a given internal ratio.
questions.question: Given \(A(1,2)\) and \(B(7,8)\), point \(P\) divides \(AB\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=1:2\). Find \(P\).
questions.hint: Apply the section formula carefully with the given ratio.

questions.concept: Midpoint Formula as a Section Formula
questions.learningObjective: Find the midpoint of a segment using the section formula.
questions.question: Find the midpoint \(M\) of the segment joining \(A(2,3)\) and \(B(6,9)\).
questions.explanation:
The midpoint corresponds to the ratio \(1:1\). Thus
\[
M=\frac{A+B}{2}
=\left(\frac{2+6}{2},\frac{3+9}{2}\right)
=(4,6).
\]
questions.hint: The midpoint is the average of the endpoint coordinates.

questions.concept: Finding a Ratio from a Point on a Segment
questions.learningObjective: Determine the ratio in which a point divides a segment.
questions.question: Point \(P(4,5)\) lies on segment \(AB\), where \(A(2,3)\) and \(B(6,7)\). Find the ratio \(AP:PB\).

questions.learningObjective: Find the coordinates of a point dividing a segment internally in a given ratio.
questions.question: Given \(A(1,1)\) and \(B(4,7)\), point \(P\) divides \(AB\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=1:2\). Find \(P\).
questions.explanation:
Using the section formula,
\[
P=\frac{nA+mB}{m+n}
\]
with \(m=1\), \(n=2\),
\[
P=\frac{2(1,1)+1(4,7)}{3}
=\left(\frac{2+4}{3},\frac{2+7}{3}\right)
=(2,3).
\]
questions.hint: Use the ratio \(AP:PB=1:2\) in the section formula.

questions.learningObjective: Find the coordinates of a point dividing a segment externally in a given ratio.
questions.question: Given \(A(1,2)\) and \(B(4,8)\), point \(P\) divides \(AB\) externally in the ratio \(AP:PB=1:2\). Find \(P\).
questions.explanation:
For external division with \(AP:PB=m:n\),
\[
P=\frac{mB-nA}{m-n}.
\]
Here \(m=1\) and \(n=2\), so
\[
P=\frac{1(4,8)-2(1,2)}{1-2}
=\frac{(4,8)-(2,4)}{-1}
=(-2,-4).
\]
questions.hint: Use the external section formula rather than the internal one.

questions.learningObjective: Find a point dividing a segment internally in a given ratio.
questions.question: Given \(A(0,0)\) and \(B(4,8)\), point \(P\) divides \(AB\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=1:3\). Find \(P\).
questions.explanation:
Using the internal section formula,
\[
P=\frac{nA+mB}{m+n}
\]
with \(m=1\), \(n=3\),
\[
P=\frac{3(0,0)+1(4,8)}{4}
=\left(\frac{4}{4},\frac{8}{4}\right)
=(1,2).
\]
questions.hint: Substitute the ratio \(1:3\) into the section formula.

questions.concept: Finding a Ratio from a Point on a Segment
questions.learningObjective: Determine the ratio in which a given point divides a segment.
questions.question: Point \(P(5,7)\) divides segment \(AB\) internally, where \(A(1,3)\) and \(B(7,9)\). Find \(AP:PB\).
questions.hint: Compare the vectors \(\vec{AP}\) and \(\vec{PB}\) as scalar multiples.

questions.learningObjective: Find a point dividing a segment internally in a non-unit ratio.
questions.question: Given \(A(1,2)\) and \(B(5,10)\), point \(P\) divides \(AB\) internally in the ratio \(AP:PB=2:3\). Find \(P\).
questions.explanation:
Using the internal section formula,
\[
P=\frac{nA+mB}{m+n}
\]
with \(m=2\), \(n=3\),
\[
P=\frac{3(1,2)+2(5,10)}{5}
=\left(\frac{3+10}{5},\frac{6+20}{5}\right)
=\left(\frac{13}{5},\frac{26}{5}\right).
\]
